01
DAY 1 · SUN 22 NOV 2026 · BANGKOK

Ease in, then rise above the city.

Mahanakhon sunset → ICONSIAM → Chinatown

Morning · arrive & recover
Morning

Airport → hotel → rest

Allow 60–90 minutes for immigration and bags. If arriving at BKK, taxi/Grab to Silom takes about 45–90 minutes; budget THB 450–800 (AED 50–89) per vehicle including a toll allowance. Airport Rail Link to Phaya Thai + BTS to Chong Nonsi takes about 60–80 minutes door to door; allow THB 80–120 (AED 9–13) per person. Leave luggage, freshen up and rest. Early check-in is not guaranteed.

Maps ↗
Afternoon · lunch before the skyline
14:30–15:30

A proper, unhurried lunch

Choose Prachak Pet Yang for roast duck (THB 150–300 / AED 17–33; ~3 km from Mahanakhon), Baan Somtum Sathorn for Isan dishes (THB 250–450 / AED 28–50; ~1.5 km), or Nalin Kitchen for relaxed Thai dishes (THB 200–450 / AED 22–50; ~2.5 km). Meal allowances per person. Published hours: Prachak about 07:00–20:30; Baan Somtum 11:00–22:00; Nalin 11:30–22:30. Reconfirm before visiting; allow 10–20 minutes to Mahanakhon from the river-side options. Prachak ↗ · Baan Somtum ↗ · Nalin Kitchen ↗

15:30 → 16:00

Leave for Mahanakhon SkyWalk

Book entry around 16:00 and confirm that your ticket permits staying through sunset. Stay for daylight, golden hour, sunset around 17:45–17:50 and early city lights. Official pages currently show differing ticket bands/hours; allow THB 1,000–1,400 (AED 111–156) per person, final sunset tariff TBD. Main official site lists 10:00–24:00, last access 23:00; reconfirm your booked date. Official SkyWalk ↗

Maps ↗
Evening · riverfront & neon
18:15 → 18:45

Across to ICONSIAM

Taxi 25–45 minutes depending on traffic, estimated THB 150–300 (AED 17–33) per vehicle. Explore SookSiam, shops, indoor areas and the riverside until about 20:15. Keep snacks light; dinner is still ahead. Usual mall hours 10:00–22:00, reconfirm.

Maps ↗
20:15 → 20:45

Chinatown & Song Wat

20:30 is the earliest target; allow 30–45 minutes in evening traffic. Yaowarat is the dinner anchor. Walk Song Wat for the streets and atmosphere, but many cafés close earlier, so do not count on a late café stop.

Maps ↗
Dinner

Roast seafood, noodle soup, something sweet

T&K Seafood: grilled prawns/fish, estimated THB 350–700 (AED 39–78), typically 16:00–02:00. Nai Ek Roll Noodles: peppery rolled-noodle soup, THB 100–200 (AED 11–22), reported 07:30–00:30. Yaowarat street stalls: THB 150–350 (AED 17–39), mainly evening; individual hours vary. All per person; reconfirm hours. T&K ↗ · Nai Ek ↗ · Song Wat ↗

Missing Indian food? :(

Saravanaa Bhavan · South Indian · vegetarian
Baan Silom / Silom Soi 19 · Vegetarian options available. Best fit: Day 1 lunch, if craving dosa.

02
DAY 2 · MON 23 NOV 2026 · BANGKOK

Royal courtyards to rooftop lights.

Grand Palace · Wat Arun · sticky rice · Phrom Phong · Tichuca

Morning · historic Bangkok
09:00–11:00

The Grand Palace

Official visitor information: 08:30–16:30, ticket sales until 15:30; admission THB 500 (AED ≈56) per person, current researched price. Cover shoulders and knees; wear proper long trousers or a long skirt, avoid transparent/ripped clothing and sleeveless tops. Check ceremonial closures. Official hours ↗

Maps ↗
11:00 → 11:30

Cross the river to Wat Arun

Walk/taxi to the appropriate cross-river pier and allow a queue. Visit 11:30–12:30. Planning hours 08:00–18:00; estimated admission THB 200 (AED ≈22) per person, reconfirm. Ferry estimate THB 5–10 (AED ≈1) per person each way.

Maps ↗
Afternoon · mango, shopping & a reset
12:30 → 13:00

K. Panich mango sticky rice

Cross back to Tha Tien and take a short taxi/tuk-tuk to Tanao Road. Allow 20–30 minutes including the ferry; car portion roughly 10–15 minutes, estimated THB 80–150 (AED 9–17) per vehicle. Mango sticky rice allowance THB 130–160 (AED 14–18) per portion. Typical hours 07:00–18:00, Sunday closure commonly listed; Monday fits, but verify. MICHELIN listing ↗

Maps ↗
13:00–14:00

Lunch in the Old Town

The sticky-rice stop can push lunch to 13:15. Choose Krua Apsorn Dinso for crab omelette / Thai dishes (THB 300–600 / AED 33–67), or Mit Ko Yuan on Dinso for tom yum / Thai stir-fries (THB 150–300 / AED 17–33). Both are roughly 500–800 m from K. Panich. Estimated per person; confirm lunchtime opening. Krua Apsorn ↗ · Mit Ko Yuan ↗

15:00–17:00

EmSphere & Phrom Phong

Allow 45–75 minutes from Old Town by taxi or MRT/BTS. Browse the shops and cafés. Walk to your chosen spa around 17:00. Usual mall hours 10:00–22:00; verify date-specific hours.

Maps ↗
17:15–18:15

Choose your massage

Keep this to 60 minutes so the rooftop and dinner remain comfortable. ThaiThai Signature, Nature Thai, Lek Gold, Healthy Massage 33 and One More Thai are all retained as choices. See the full comparison below. Compare all five spas ↓

Evening · rooftop, dinner & optional nightlife
18:45–19:30

Tichuca Rooftop Bar

T-One Building, Sukhumvit 40: roughly 2–3 km from Phrom Phong, about 15–30 minutes by BTS to Thong Lo plus walking, or taxi. Official FAQ: opens daily 17:00 till late; walk-ins only; free entry; age 20+; foreign guests need an original passport. Best for drinks, views and photos; treat light food as optional, not a full dinner. Cocktails estimated THB 400–650 (AED 44–72) each; snack allowance THB 250–500 (AED 28–56), current food menu TBD. Queue/weather may shorten the visit. Official entry rules ↗

Maps ↗
19:45–20:45

Sit down for a proper dinner

Near Thong Lo: Baan Ice for southern Thai (THB 300–650 / AED 33–72), or Supanniga Eating Room Thonglor for regional Thai (THB 500–900 / AED 56–100). About 1–2 km from Tichuca; prices estimated per person, confirm evening service. Baan Ice ↗ · Supanniga ↗

20:30 onward

Soi Cowboy / Asok, if you feel like it

20:30 is the earliest option; with a relaxed dinner, 21:00–21:30 is more realistic. Take BTS/taxi to Asok and explore at your own pace. If the rooftop queue is long, keep nightlife optional.

Maps ↗

Afternoon · settle in, then the Old City
13:15

Hotel / luggage / freshen up

Airport to Old City / Tha Phae Gate: about 20–40 minutes, longer with festival closures. Estimated car THB 200–400 (AED 22–44) per vehicle. Keep the hotel central; store bags if the room is not ready.

13:45

Northern lunch near the route

Khao Soi Khun Yai for a quick northern curry-noodle lunch (THB 80–150 / AED 9–17; often closes around 14:00, use only if on time), or Huen Phen for northern Thai dishes (THB 200–400 / AED 22–44). Estimates per person. Khun Yai ↗ · Huen Phen ↗

Wat Chedi Luang → Old City → Tha Phae Gate

About 40 minutes at Wat Chedi Luang; estimated entry THB 50–100 (AED 6–11), planning hours 08:00–17:00, reconfirm. Wander Old City streets/cafés from 15:15 and reach Tha Phae Gate around 16:00. No additional attractions.

Maps ↗
Evening · Yi Peng + Loy Krathong
Late afternoon onward

Follow the festival, slowly

Walk through the lantern decorations toward the Ping River / Nawarat Bridge. Use the hotel’s current pedestrian route because road closures are likely. Eat at Chiang Mai Night Bazaar food stalls (THB 150–350 / AED 17–39 per person, estimated), or Rajdarbar if you want an Indian backup. Public ceremonies and krathong activities depend on the municipal programme.

Maps ↗

Public streets, lantern atmosphere

THE DEFAULT PLAN · FREE PUBLIC ACCESS

Yi Peng brings Lanna lantern decorations and ceremonies; Loy Krathong centres on floating krathongs. Enjoy Old City lanes, Tha Phae Gate and the Ping River. General street access is free; a krathong is an estimated THB 50–150 (AED 6–17).

The official CAAT aviation notice covers 24–25 November 2026. It supports the dates, but is not the final municipal parade programme or permission for a private release. Local celebration times and authorised activity points remain TBD.

Official 2026 notice ↗

A paid mass release is a separate choice

OPTIONAL · NOT IN BASE BUDGET

Organised events outside the centre use tickets and transfers. A current SGC listing advertises 24 / 25 Nov at THB 4,600 Standard (AED ≈511) or THB 6,400 Premium (AED ≈711), with transfers. Listing price is not a guarantee of inventory or event permission.

Some CAD packages require around 13:00 pickup: that is too tight after a 12:20 airport arrival and replaces your Old City afternoon. Do not buy until the organiser confirms a workable pickup and return for 24 Nov. You leave Chiang Mai on 25 Nov.

DAY 6 · FRI 27 NOV 2026 · KRABI

Railay, Phra Nang, a little kayaking and an Ao Nang sunset

Morning · take it slowly
09:00

Late breakfast

Hotel breakfast or Café 8.98 Ao Nang for coffee and eggs; estimated THB 200–400 (AED 22–44) per person.

Ao Nang → Railay by longtail

Buy at the Ao Nang beach boat cooperative / ticket booths. Typical daylight operation roughly 08:00–18:00, subject to demand and sea conditions; boats may wait to fill. Crossing 10–20 minutes. Estimated THB 100 (AED ≈11) per person each way / THB 200 (AED ≈22) return. Verify which operator honours your return and agree a 16:00–16:30 boat; do not rely on a late boat.

Railay Beach → Phra Nang Beach & Cave

Walk between Railay West and Phra Nang, about 15–25 minutes. Enjoy the limestone scenery, cave shrine and beach. No extra viewpoint climb. Beach/cave access normally free; any local charges TBD. Phra Nang Beach & Cave ↗

Maps ↗

Lunch on Railay

Choose Railay Family Restaurant for Thai dishes (THB 150–300 / AED 17–33), or Local Thai Food Restaurant on the walking-street side (THB 150–350 / AED 17–39). Per-person estimates; ask about fresh fish prices. Railay Family ↗ · Local Thai Food ↗

Kayak, then shade

Rent from beach operators on Railay West. Estimate THB 200–400 (AED 22–44) per kayak / hour; agree duration, life jackets and safe area. Alternatively, take a guided beginner climbing session: typical half-day 3–4 hours, estimated THB 1,500–2,500 (AED 167–278) per person with equipment. Climbing replaces kayaking and some beach time; choose a morning session if the afternoon ends too late. Beginner climbing options ↗

Return to Ao Nang

Check return boat conditions before settling in for lunch. Allow time for waiting and boarding, then shower at the hotel.

Go-karting · Wat Chalong · Big Buddha · Karon Viewpoint · Promthep Cape

Morning · start with something fun
09:30

Late breakfast

Hotel breakfast or The Coffee Club around Patong for a convenient sit-down start; estimated THB 250–450 (AED 28–50) per person. Leave Patong around 10:15.

Maps ↗
11:00–12:00

Go-karting: choose one venue

Formula Fun Karting, 138/1 Moo 5 Bypass Road, Ratsada: indoor electric karts and a colourful track. Current reported adult regular session THB 1,000 (AED ≈111), 8 minutes; quicker Formula kart THB 1,500 (AED ≈167). Afternoon · a single temple & the coast
12:15–13:15

Lunch near the southbound route

Kan Eang @ Pier in Chalong for seafood (THB 500–900 / AED 56–100), or a simple Thai meal around Chalong Circle (THB 150–300 / AED 17–33). Estimated per person. Allow 30–45 minutes from Ratsada to Chalong; adjust lunch start for traffic.

Maps ↗
13:45–14:30

Wat Chalong

The one main Phuket temple. Typically 08:00–17:00, grounds free; donations optional. Allow 45 minutes and dress modestly. Reconfirm access around ceremonies.

Maps ↗
14:45–15:45

Phuket Big Buddha · Nakkerd Hill

Continue from Wat Chalong to the 45-metre white marble Big Buddha for panoramic island views. Allow about 45–60 minutes at the site. Admission is free; dress modestly with shoulders and knees covered. Reconfirm opening and road access shortly before the trip, as access conditions have changed previously.

Maps ↗
16:10–16:35

Karon Viewpoint

Continue south after Big Buddha. Keep this as a short 20–25 minute viewpoint stop so the sunset buffer stays comfortable.

Maps ↗
17:00 → sunset

Promthep Cape, comfortably early

Allow 25–40 minutes from Karon Viewpoint including parking. Aim for 16:30–17:00 at the cape, well before sunset around 18:05–18:10 (astronomical planning window). Free entry; stay on accessible viewing areas. If traffic builds, shorten Karon, not the sunset buffer.

Maps ↗

Do this in order

Book these first.

Book these first

  1. International flights: 21 Nov night SHJ→BKK and 2 Dec 18:20 HKT→SHJ target; get exact-date fare and baggage.
  2. DMK→CNX, 24 Nov: preserve 11:10–12:20 target; verify flight number and festival schedule changes.
  3. CEI→DMK→KBV, 26 Nov: verify the 13:25–18:10 itinerary, connection and protected booking.
  4. Chiang Mai hotel, 24–25 Nov: festival availability is the tightest hotel constraint.
  5. Phi Phi, 28–29 Nov, and Phuket, 29 Nov–2 Dec: choose convenient, quiet rooms.
  6. Paid Yi Peng only if selected: check ticket legitimacy, permitted release, pickup and return before paying.
  7. GreenBus VIP and sea crossings: book once dated services are released; keep weather flexibility.

Can book later

  • Massage: a few days ahead; reserve the final morning once your flight is confirmed.
  • Restaurants: book the special final-night table earlier; casual meals can stay flexible.
  • Local taxis: on demand for short rides; prebook airport and long sightseeing cars.
  • Kayaking: choose locally after checking wind and sea.
  • Railay boats: confirm the return arrangement on the day.
  • Phi Phi tour: reserve with flexible terms and a written lunchtime return; reconfirm 24–48 hours before.
  • Karting: check opening and availability a few days ahead.
A week before travel: recheck attraction hours, festival programme, park status and all baggage rules. 48 hours before each sea journey: verify pier, pickup, weather and cancellation policy. The route and dates stay fixed; adjust only local timing if operations require it.
Seasonal guidance, not a forecast

Warm days. Cooler northern nights.

Climatological planning ranges for late November / early December, not a forecast for your dates. Check the short-range forecast 7 days out and marine conditions each boat morning.

PlaceTypical day / nightWhat that means
Bangkok29–33°C / 23–25°CWarm city walks; occasional showers. Temple layers and water.
Chiang Mai27–30°C / 16–20°CUsually drier; cooler evenings. A light jacket after the festival.
Chiang Rai25–29°C / 14–19°CCooler mornings; a layer for the bus and café.
Krabi / Ao Nang29–32°C / 23–25°CRain and swell remain possible during the seasonal transition.
Phi Phi29–31°C / 24–26°CWind affects crossings, snorkelling visibility and longtail routes.
Phuket29–32°C / 24–26°CShowers possible; follow beach flags and marine warnings.

Research & transparency

The details behind the journey.

Checked 24 September 2026. Current researched means a published price or policy was found, not a booking or a future guarantee. Observed means supplied during trip planning. Estimated means an allowance. TBD means no reliable confirmation was obtained. Maps links are place searches: confirm the correct branch before navigating.

Still to confirm: exact-date international fares; domestic airline / flight numbers / baggage; CEI–DMK–KBV sector and layover times; final municipal festival programme; November bus/boat inventory; selected hotels; several spa tariffs and restaurant hours. These gaps are explicitly labelled rather than filled with invented details.
